name: Xie Yida
source:
"Consider this. Suppose that the mind is like a bottle of water."

Xie Yida, also known as the "Profane Scalpel," is a notorious and brilliant scientist known for his advances in the research of soul transfer - digitalization and storage of a person's memories and personality. Due to the dangers of his research, he was blacklisted and cast out of the scientific society. He runs a black market clinic, providing augmentations for criminals to fund his research.

He is the one who performed the soul transfer on [url=/c7182]Kong Ruili[/url]. Awaiting [url=/c7177]Kong Taoluo[/url]'s return to Shanghai, he had prepared a specialized gynoid to store Ruili's soul data. The final step in his reseach being to store the entirety of the soul data within one body.
